title: No matter where you go, buying a house in Taipei is expensive
alt: Map of Taipei City divided into five house price zones, interpolated from Airbnb listings using natural neighbor interpolation; prices range from about NTD 0.9 million to NTD 494 million.
description: While we identify very few highly expensive house zone prices in Taipei City, Taiwan, the spread across the city is usually above NTD 14.9 million. The analysis identified five price zones in Taipei City. It employed 898 house price listings from Airbnb to interpolate each zone using the Natural Neighbors estimation. Each range zone comes from the weighted spatial influence of each listing price to smooth over missing areas within the city. The more clustered listings appear, the more precise the interpolation is illustrated. Data from Airbnb listings from 2024.
